mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM rooms WHERE id = #{roomId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM activities WHERE id = #{activityId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_activity (user_id, activity_id, device_id, member_generation, operation_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityId}, #{deviceId}, #{memberGeneration}, #{operationId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET activity_id = EXCLUDED.activity_id, device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id, member_generation = EXCLUDED.member_generation, operation_id = EXCLUDED.operation_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM activity_members WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND state IN ('ACTIVE', 'GRACE')
SELECT * FROM activity_members WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM activity_members WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY joined_at, user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_members (activity_id, user_id, device_id, member_generation, state, joined_at, grace_expires_at) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{memberGeneration}, #{state}, #{joinedAt}, #{graceExpiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (activity_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id, member_generation = EXCLUDED.member_generation, state = EXCLUDED.state, grace_expires_at = EXCLUDED.grace_expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM connection_leases WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY member_generation DESC, expires_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO connection_leases (id, activity_id, user_id, device_id, activity_generation, member_generation, policy_revision, voice_state, network_state, expires_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{activityId}, #{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{activityGeneration}, #{memberGeneration}, #{policyRevision}, #{voiceState}, #{networkState}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE connection_leases SET voice_state = #{voiceState}, network_state = #{networkState}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ipv4 FROM ip_allocations WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND released_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM ip_allocations WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ip_allocations (activity_id, user_id, ipv4, allocated_at, released_at) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{userId}, #{ipv4}, #{allocatedAt}, #{releasedAt}) ON CONFLICT (activity_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET ipv4 = EXCLUDED.ipv4, allocated_at = EXCLUDED.allocated_at, released_at = EXCLUDED.released_at
mapper.update: UPDATE ip_allocations SET released_at = #{releasedAt} WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ip_history WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ip_history (room_id, user_id, last_ipv4, last_activity_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{lastIpv4}, #{lastActivityId}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (room_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET last_ipv4 = EXCLUDED.last_ipv4, last_activity_id = EXCLUDED.last_activity_id, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity_members WHERE state = 'GRACE' AND grace_expires_at <= #{now}
